charts.axisNote: Each unit gets its own vertical axis. A break in a line means the device reported no value for those fixes — for Battery, that also happens while it is charging.
charts.decimated: Drawing {{drawn}} of {{total}} points — the highest and lowest reading of every ticked series is kept, so no peak is hidden.
charts.emptyBody: No GPS fixes were recorded in the selected time range.
charts.noneSelectedBody: Tick one or more series above to plot them.
charts.noPositions: No positions found for this time range.
charts.notReported: Not reported in this time range
charts.truncated: This range holds more than {{limit}} fixes, which is as far back as one load goes, so the chart starts at {{start}} rather than at the “From” you chose. Narrow the range to see earlier data.

map.noApiKey: The map cannot be displayed: no Google Maps API key is configured for this deployment.
map.noPositions: No positions found for this time range.
map.notConfigured:
Map not configured.
Set CARPOS_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY on the frontend container to enable it.
map.reachedCap: Loaded the newest {{value}} positions — this range holds more than one load can fetch, so the track starts later than the “From” you chose.

notFoundOrNoAccess: Device not found, or you do not have access to it.

positions.emptyBody: No GPS fixes were recorded in the selected time range.
positions.exportedCapped: Exported the newest {{value}} positions — the range holds more than the {{limit}}-row limit.
positions.loadingForExport: Loading the rest of the range for the export…
positions.loadingForSort: Loading the rest of the range so the sort covers all of it…
positions.noneInRange: No positions found for this time range.
